First-time Supabase setup (one time only)
1. Supabase mein new project banayein. 2. SQL Editor mein neeche wala table/policy SQL run karein. 3. Project URL aur anon key yahan enter karein. 4. Cloud account create karke Connect & Sync karein. Service-role key kabhi yahan paste na karein.
create table if not exists public.fee_app_data (
  user_id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.fee_app_data enable row level security;

create policy "Users can read own fee data" on public.fee_app_data
for select using (auth.uid() = user_id);

create policy "Users can insert own fee data" on public.fee_app_data
for insert with check (auth.uid() = user_id);

create policy "Users can update own fee data" on public.fee_app_data
for update using (auth.uid() = user_id) with check (auth.uid() = user_id);

create policy "Users can delete own fee data" on public.fee_app_data
for delete using (auth.uid() = user_id);

revoke all on table public.fee_app_data from anon;
grant select, insert, update, delete on table public.fee_app_data to authenticated;
